kebab_example: aliyun polardb delete-db-cluster --cloud-provider ENS --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --backup-retention-policy-on-cluster-deletion NONE --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDBCluster

parameters.help_en: The cloud service provider of the instance
parameters.name: cloud_provider

parameters.help_en:
The retention policy for backup sets when the cluster is deleted. Valid values:

ALL: permanently retains all backup sets.

LATEST: permanently retains the last backup set. The system automatically creates a new backup before the cluster is deleted.

NONE: does not retain any backup sets after the cluster is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
删除集群时备份集保留策略，取值范围如下：
ALL：长期保留全部备份。
LATEST：长期保留最后一个备份（删除前自动备份）。
NONE：集群删除时不保留备份集
parameters.name: backup_retention_policy_on_cluster_deletion
